verdict.rationale: Background automations are a fair question for an email service, which could ship scheduled sends or workflow automation, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only developer building blocks: send APIs, webhooks for event notifications, and inbound parsing. Nothing documents a Postmark-native automation, recurring schedule, or autonomous workflow a user can set up, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
